Class FlightBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.FlightBoard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class FlightBoard extends Object implements Serializable
The FlightBoard class manages the positions and rankings of players during the flight phase of the game. It tracks which players are still in flight, which have landed, and provides movement and ranking logic.
